text:
Maya (Support): Heads-up — auto-charge failed for Acme Inc invoice #INV-2026-04-13 (PO 98765). Customer says card worked yesterday, now declining. Attaching gateway snippets below.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-04-13 created for Acme Inc — amount €12,450 — auto-charge scheduled.

Maya (Support): Payment attempt returned: {"code":"card_declined","decline_code":"insufficient_funds","gateway":"stripe","attempt":1} 

Ben (Payments): Thanks. Can you paste the raw webhook/log (redact full PAN) and the last4? Also confirm if this was a recurring merchant-initiated flow or a one-off invoice capture, and customer region.

Maya (Support): Raw snippet (redacted): ```event: charge.failed
data: {id: ch_1JXXXX, outcome: {type: "issuer_declined", reason: "insufficient_funds", risk_level: "normal"}}``` Last4: 1111. Customer billing country: DE. This is recurring (monthly invoice). We retried once from the UI; second attempt returned 402 + decline_code: "fraudulent".

Ben (Payments): Issuer_declined / insufficient_funds for attempt 1 is straightforward. The subsequent "fraudulent" tag suggests the gateway/risk engine flagged the retry pattern. Note: for EU SCA, recurring MIT (merchant-initiated) requires prior authorisation or exemptions. If the original payment_method lacks MIT/recurring flags, automatic server-side retries may trigger a 3DS challenge or a risk decline that can't be completed in server-to-server flows.

Lina (Acct Exec): Quick context — customer is on a PO workflow and finance insisted we attach PO 98765. Finance says PO was uploaded but I see our billing record didn't include metadata.po_number on the charge. Could missing PO metadata have blocked retries or caused some downstream rule?

Jasper (Eng): Missing metadata shouldn't directly cause issuer declines but can affect downstream reconciliation rules and certain gateway routing rules. Repro steps to simulate: 
```
POST /v1/invoices/:id/pay
Body: { auto_retry: true, metadata: { po_number: "98765" } }
```
I'll try a sandbox run with a DE test card that will require SCA on retry.

Ben (Payments): Two separate issues to fix:
- Business: insufficient funds from the issuer -> customer action (new funding or retry later).
- Risk/SCA: our retry pattern is causing the gateway to escalate to "fraudulent" / 3DS. We must detect when a payment method is NOT MIT-capable and avoid server-side retries that will fail. Instead surface a manual pay link.

billing-bot: System scheduled retry: attempt 2 in 6 hours (policy: smart-retry).

Maya (Support): Customer is blocked and asking for immediate resolution. Can we offer a manual invoice pay link or process a one-time card update? What's the quickest supported flow so we don't lose the renewal?

Lina (Acct Exec): I told them to add a new card via hosted billing page; customer said they'll update but asked if we can temporarily disable auto-retry to stop fraud flags while they update.

Jasper (Eng): Actionable: add an audit gate in the retry path to check payment_method.usage / payment_method.card.three_d_secure_usage and metadata.po_number. If MIT/recurring flag missing -> don't auto-retry, instead surface a clear support note with manual pay link. I'll scope a PR, ETA 48h.

Ben (Payments): I'll pull the full gateway logs and confirm whether we can request a manual re-evaluation or remove the fraud flag. If not, we proceed with customer-supplied card update. Action items: 
1) Support (Maya) — confirm last4 + ask customer to submit new card or use pay link (ASAP).
2) Payments (Ben) — full log pull + determine whether retry set triggered risk rules; advise if we can clear the flag.
3) Eng (Jasper) — add audit gate + surface MIT flag in UI (48h).
4) Acct Exec (Lina) — follow up with finance re: PO metadata attach process.

Maya (Support): :thumbsup: Opening a support case with customer steps now and will DM updated logs to Ben when available. Will update thread when customer confirms card update.

Ben (Payments): I'll create a payments follow-up ticket and tag this thread. If gateway suggests we can request a manual review, I'll escalate.

Lina (Acct Exec): Thanks — please cc me on the manual pay link if you send it.

Jasper (Eng): Noted. I'll start a branch and post the PR link here once ready.

Maya (Support): Closing loop for now — customer is trying to add a new card; if they succeed we'll re-run the invoice pay manually. Will post outcome.
